$comment: Reference schema for the structured output produced by workflows/task-breakdown.md. Not machine-validated yet — kept here as the template the agent fills in.

workstreams.title: string
workstreams.description: string — specific enough that a worker could pick it up cold
workstreams.risk_notes: string (optional) — flag anything uncertain about the estimate or scope

schedule.algorithm: list scheduling (longest-processing-time-first), respecting depends_on, across num_workers

eta.wall_clock_hours: number — makespan given num_workers and dependencies
